text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grand showdown held in Kyoto, a city 
rich with shrines and temples... The 
curtains rise on the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with the unknown distance 
of 3,000 meters, Matikanefukukitaru 
maintains a positive attitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting everything to god and good 
fortune, she charged into the grueling 
long-distance race!
